info.name: API Reference Accounting Codes Product Charge Definitions API

params.name: charge
params.description: The unique number or ID of the charge for which the product charge definitions are to be retrieved.

params.name: rateplan
params.description: The unique number or ID of the product rate plan for which the product charge definitions are to be retrieved.

params.name: hide-inherited-values
params.description: The flag that controls whether the response will merge the default charge definition fields for those fields that are not overridden.

items.docs:
Retrieves basic information about the product charge definitions. 

**Note**: This operation requires the [Attribute-based Pricing](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Zuora_Billing/Build_products_and_prices/Attribute_based_pricing/AA_Overview_of_Attribute-based_Pricing) feature to be enabled, which is in the **Early Adopter** phase.

Creates a product charge definition for a charge. You can create as many product charge definitions as needed for one charge.

In the request, you must specify the unique ID or number of the charge for which this charge definition is to be created. 
The ID or number of a product rate plan is optional.

**Note**: This operation requires the [Attribute-based Pricing](https://knowledgecenter.zuora.com/Zuora_Billing/Build_products_and_prices/Attribute_based_pricing/AA_Overview_of_Attribute-based_Pri

In the request, you must specify the unique ID or number of the charge for which this charge definition is to be created. 
The ID or number of a product rate plan is optional.
